name: MUMBLE
author: Kiryl Dziamura
tagline: retro-game characters that sing what you type
description: Eight retro-game characters sing a line you type. SING it a syllable a key, with the choir on auto-chords and an arpeggiator; record it into a multitrack LOOP that follows MIDI clock; or TYPE and hear it spoken. Every character has their own voice and pixel face, built from their sound, with CRUSH, RADIO, ECHO and ROOM; LFO rolls a new one.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
